parameters.help_en: The custom unique business identifier used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value must be a unique combination of up to 32 letters and digits
parameters.help_zh:
您自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。
支持长度为32位的字母和数字的组合，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The MetaInfo environment parameter, which must be obtained by using the client SDK
parameters.help_zh: MetaInfo环境参数，需要通过客户端SDK获取
parameters.name: meta_info

parameters.help_en:
The type of the ID document. Valid values:
IDENTITY_CARD: second-generation resident ID card
parameters.help_zh:
证件类型
居民二代身份证：IDENTITY_CARD
parameters.name: card_type

parameters.help_en:
The verification method. Valid values:
OCR_VERIFY: OCR recognition and authentication mode
parameters.help_zh:
核验方式，取值：
OCR_VERIFY：OCR识别且认证模式
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en:
The verification type. Valid values:
ID_2_META: two identity elements (name and ID number)
parameters.help_zh:
核验类型，取值：
身份二要素（姓名+身份证号）：ID_2_META
parameters.name: verify_meta

parameters.help_en:
The number of pages of the ID document collected by the SDK. Valid values:
1: collects the front side.
2: collects the front and back sides.
If the verification type is the validity period of the ID document (VerifyMeta is set to ID_PERIOD), you must set this parameter to 2
parameters.help_zh:
SDK采集卡证页数
可以输入1和2， 输入1采集正面，输入2采集正面+反面。

如果核验类型是身份证有效期（VerifyMeta取值ID_PERIOD），必须输入2
parameters.name: card_page_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to temporarily store the image information collected by the app. Valid values:
Y: yes. If you select this value, the query API can return the image information of the ID document.
N: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否临时存储app采集图片信息。
Y：是
N：否
如果此处选择是，在查询接口支持返回卡证图片信息
parameters.name: picture_save

parameters.help_en:
The callback URL for authentication results. The URL must start with https. After the authentication is completed, the platform calls back this URL and automatically adds the certifyId and passed fields. Example: https://www.aliyun.com?certifyId=xxxx&passed=T.
Warning: The callback is triggered only when the authentication is completed. If the authentication is abandoned, abnormally interrupted, or not performed, no notification is sent. When you receive the callback notification, call the query API to obtain the authentication details if needed
parameters.help_zh:
认证结果的回调通知地址，必须以https开头。
平台在完成认证后会回调该地址，并自动添加certifyId、passed字段，示例：https://www.aliyun.com?certifyId=xxxx&passed=T
警告
仅当认证完成时才会触发回调，若认证中放弃、异常中断或未进行认证均不会通知。建议您收到回调通知时，若有需要可通过查询接口获取认证详情资料信息
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The security token used for anti-replay and anti-tampering verification. If you specify this parameter, the CallbackToken field is displayed in the callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 安全Token，用于防重复、防篡改校验。如果传入该参数会在回调地址显示CallbackToken字段
parameters.name: callback_token

parameters.help_en:
The photo capture mode. Valid values:
shoot: photo capture.
scan: scanning.
auto: automatic switchover
parameters.help_zh:
拍照方式枚举(手动/ 自动拍照)
拍照 shoot
扫描 scan 
自动切换 auto
parameters.name: doc_scan_mode

Code.description_en:
The return code. A value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure.
Important:
This parameter indicates whether the API is called successfully. For more information about return codes, see Error codes.
To view the business result, check the fields in ResultObject
Code.description_zh:
返回码：200为成功，其他为失败。
重要
此参数代表是否正确调用了接口，详细的返回码说明请参见错误码。
业务结果请通过ResultObject中的字段查看

CertifyId.description_en:
The verification request ID, which is the unique identifier of the authentication request in the verification service.
When you query the authentication result, you must specify the authentication request ID.
The CertifyId field is used for billing statistics. To facilitate subsequent bill reconciliation, store the field information locally. The CertifyId returned by the initialization API is valid for 30 minutes and can be submitted for authentication only once. Use it within the validity period to avoid repeated use
CertifyId.description_zh:
核验请求ID，核验服务认证请求的唯一标识。
查询认证结果时，必须传入认证请求ID。

CertifyId字段为计费统计字段，为了方便后续核对账单，请您在本地留存该字段信息。初始化接口返回的认证CertifyId在30分钟有效且仅能认证提交一次，请您在有效期内应用，避免重复使用
